changelog:
- Pure Network-Level Blocking Architecture: Purged invasive JavaScript DOM-tampering scripts in favor of pure network-level blocking (matching Brave Browser and uBlock Origin).
- Normal Browser Feed Restored: Reddit, Instagram, Twitter, and social feeds now render with 100% native web layouts, smooth virtual scrolling, and zero stacked/overlapping cards.
- Zero Video Buffering Stall: Instant media startup on YouTube and video platforms with untouched network resolution and zero promise delay.
- Unlocked News Reading: Restored clean article loading on The Sun, Fox News, and The Guardian without modal lockups or hidden article bodies.
- Network-Level CMP & Cookie Banner Defusers: Intercepts OneTrust, Cookiebot, Sourcepoint, and Google Funding Choices scripts at the network layer before they execute.
- URL Tracking Cleaner: Strips invasive query parameters (fbclid, gclid, utm_*, igshid, si) from outbound and shared links.
